oracle.scope: Single resource and field rules only, explicit definitions for later composition and lint consumers.

preconditions: Explicit profile bytes and artifact values; no hidden CLI or project selection.
steps: Parse exact versioned declarations and verify resource hashes.
Check scoped field effects, passive rule definitions, and unchanged mixed-language contents.
Reject executable declarations, incompatible formats/versions and changed or incorrectly bound project resources.
